toolsPreview.name: search_best
toolsPreview.description: Find what AI models agree is the best product/tool/service for a need, or look up how a specific brand ranks. Returns matching categories and brands with a dated one-sentence verdict and source URLs. Use for any 'best X for Y' question. Excludes medical, financial, and legal advice.

toolsPreview.name: get_best_in_category
toolsPreview.description: Get the full ranked leaderboard and verdict for a category slug (obtained from search_best or list_categories), e.g. 'best-llm-observability'.

toolsPreview.name: get_product
toolsPreview.description: Get a single brand/product's record across every category it is ranked in, with verdicts and its homepage.

toolsPreview.name: get_poll_history
toolsPreview.description: Get the raw poll history — every model's pick over time — behind a category's verdict. The credibility/audit trail. Optionally filter by model.

toolsPreview.name: list_categories
toolsPreview.description: List every category ModelsAgree ranks (slug + title). Large; prefer search_best when you have a specific need.
